{{Quote|Alone against all these droids&hellip; Heh, ''they'' don't stand a chance.|Boss|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
'''Boss''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. He was designated '''RC-01/138'''—simplified as '''RC-1138''' and also known as '''Delta-38''', then known as '''IC-1138''' as part of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]]. Born in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] on the [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Boss was trained by the Mandalorian ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Walon Vau]] to become a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Placed in command of three other [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], Boss led the elite [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] as their [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Boss took his place in the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Arligan Zey]], and served alongside his clone brothers in [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] on a number of battlefields, ranging from the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|the halls]] of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|RAS]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'', and [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|the streets]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to snowy [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] and [[Battle of Haurgab|the plains]] of [[Haurgab]]. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Boss and the other members of Delta Squad—minus squadmate [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], whom the squad had been forced to [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|abandon]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the final days of the Clone Wars—served in the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], as members of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], a specialized unit within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] tasked with hunting down [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] deserters, [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|fugitive]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sympathizers.

==Biography==
===Early life and training===
{{Quote|Identified my squad leader today. RC-1138 repeatedly tops squad in weapons and tactics testing and broke my arm in melee test.|RC Batch Delta: Report: W Vau, Training Sergeant|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
RC-1138 was born in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], in the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Clone military education complex|facilities]] of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], on the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], RC-1138 was created to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] and, following a course of [[flash training]], was placed under the direct training of the Mandalorian ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Walon Vau]]. As his training progressed, Three-Eight proved himself an incredibly capable [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], consistently scoring the highest of his clone brothers in weapon and tactics training. During a test of his [[Unarmed combat/Legends|melee]] skills with his training sergeant, Three-Eight broke Walon Vau's arm. With these accomplishments in mind, Vau assigned RC-1138 to [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]],<ref name="RepCom" /> one of the first [[Commando/Legends|commando]] squads established by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], where he would serve as its [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], and thus came to be known as Boss to his three squadmates, [[RC-1140/Legends|RC-1140]] "Fixer," [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="RepCom" />

===Geonosis===
[[File:Delta_Squad.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Boss leading Delta Squad of the Republic.]]
The Grand Army would finally see action in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] took the army to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Boss and the other members of Delta Squad were sent to Geonosis in a deployment so hastily ordered and carried out that it left Delta no time to say goodbye to their training sergeant, Vau.<ref name="TZ" /> The four commandos split up, each boarding a single [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] independently, with the intention of rendezvousing once on the surface of Geonosis. Aboard his gunship, Boss spoke with [[Advisor/Legends|Clone advisor]] [[01/425]], with the latter introducing himself and reminding Delta Squad of its tasking, [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]]. As the gunship landed, it was assaulted by a single Geonosian warrior; Boss was helpless to stop it from quickly killing another [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who had ridden with him in the troop bay.<ref name="RepCom" />

Once on the ground, Boss was called upon to destroy an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] bunker on his way to rendezvous with the other members of his squad, a task he completed utilizing a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Upon reuniting with his other squadmates, Boss and the rest of Delta Squad attacked Sun Fac in his command center, but the Geonosian leader managed to escape. Delta tracked Fac through the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|Geonosian catacombs]], eventually catching up with him in Fac's private hangar as the Geonosian attempted to escape in his [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Fac's escape was prevented by the timely actions of Delta Squad's [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], Sev, who used the [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniping attachment]] of his [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] to shoot down the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], killing Fac.<ref name="RepCom" /> While hunting for Sun Fac, Delta Squad had engaged a number of [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid|spider droids]] while their fellow Republic commando unit, [[Theta Squad]], [[Thermal detonator tape|blew]] through a door in the catacombs. Boss had been in contact with Theta's demolition expert, [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]], and had emphatically encouraged the commando to make haste. Once the door was down, Delta was given leave to enter and fire on the Geonosians inside,<ref name="HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> while Theta moved off to destroy a [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factory]]. Once Sun Fac was dead, Delta Squad's advisor informed them that Theta Squad had failed in their objective;<ref name="RepCom" /> [[Taler (clone commando)|Taler]], [[Vin (clone commando)|Vin]], and [[Jay (clone commando)|Jay]] had been [[Death/Legends|killed]], leaving RC-1136 the only survivor.<ref name="HC" /> Boss and his Delta squadmates infiltrated the factory—their route taking them through an area filled with Geonosian [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]—and successfully destroy it by targeting specific weak points in the factory's design.<ref name="RepCom" />

Following the destruction of the droid factory, Delta Squad was ordered to infiltrate a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]]. Deployed in a nearby canyon from an LAAT/i gunship [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Delta 42]], Delta Squad made their way to the Core Ship, using a downed gunship's [[Composite-beam laser|composite-beam]] turrets to fend off enemy Geonosians along the way. As they continued toward the Core Ship, Boss and his squad were called upon to take out an [[Anti-aircraft cannon/Legends|anti-aircraft cannon]]. The commandos fought through a number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and their [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] counterparts, before finally destroying the large anti-aircraft emplacement. When the squad finally reached the Core Ship, they were met with resistance from an [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid|advanced spider droid]] and a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] blocking the ship's entrance. The four commandos were able to destroy the spider droid with considerable effort—with Boss making note of his desire never to have to engage one again—and they then called in air support from Delta 42's gunship to blow through the ray-shielded entrance.<ref name="RepCom" />

Once inside, Delta Squad split up, each of its members tasked with sabotaging and destroying various crucial systems: Boss struck at the super battle droid storage racks. When Scorch and Fixer came under heavy fire from a small number of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], Boss and Sev were able to rescue them without incident. Their primary objective, however, was the capture of vital launch codes housed on the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. On the bridge, Delta came under heavy fire from numerous battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and stationary [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]], but still managed to acquire the codes before retreating down a branching corridor. By then, the squad's efforts to sabotage the Core Ship had come to full fruition, with several primary systems overloading. With no time to escape back the way they had come, Delta Squad was extracted via LAAT/i gunship through a hole forcefully blown in the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ship.<ref name="RepCom" />

The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] would be the first action Boss and his brothers from Delta Squad saw, but with the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] breaking out throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], it would not be the last. Delta would prove to be one of the lucky minority of Republic commando squads to depart Geonosis intact and with no casualties; 4,982 other commandos perished on Geonosis' [[Color/Legends|red]] sands.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

===Mission to the ''Prosecutor''===
{{Quote|The ''Prosecutor'' was our first home. We were stationed there for a long time.|Boss|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
One day before the first anniversary of the Battle of Geonosis, three hundred and sixty-seven days into the Clone Wars, Boss and the rest of Delta Squad were called upon to [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|investigate]] the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], ''[[Prosecutor]]''. Having recently reappeared in the [[Chaykin Cluster]] following a two-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long disappearance while tasked with defending [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], the ''Prosecutor'' was found drifting, without power or communication capability. Delta Squad had spent a substantial amount of time aboard the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] during the early portion of the war, and Boss had even come to think of it as their "first home". Arriving on scene in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]] aboard a [[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carrier]], Delta Squad was tasked with retrieving flight records from the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} four [[Datacore/Legends|data cores]] and securing the derelict [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]].<ref name="RepCom" />

[[File:RC-1138boss.jpg|thumb|250px|Boss, wearing his distinctive orange-painted armor aboard the ''Prosecutor''.]]
The four members of Delta Squad disembarked from the CR25 via a jump through the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], splitting up and entering the ''Prosecutor'' at four different locations. Interference in their [[Comm unit/Legends|comms]] would quickly cut Boss and the others off from the guidance of 01/425, who was again serving as mission advisor to the squad. While searching through the ship, Delta Squad came across few survivors, and several members were set upon by [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droids]]; Scorch was ambushed and incapacitated by the droids. Shortly after, the squad found that the ''Prosecutor'' has been attacked by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[Trandoshan Elites|mercenaries]] when Sev was attacked and captured at the starboard data core where Boss had been waiting to meet him, and Boss was forced to flee into the ship's maintenance shafts. Despite this, Boss was able to complete his original objective, battling through heavily armed and armored Trandoshan [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and the ship's very own autoturret defenses that had been [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] by the Trandoshans, before rendezvousing with Fixer and proceeding to rescue Sev. Once Sev was free of the violent interrogation from his Trandoshan captors, the incomplete squad moved to retrieve Scorch from where he was being held in the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} [[detention area]]. After a brief skirmish in the detention area, Delta Squad was able to locate and revive an incapacitated Scorch, and together make their way to the bridge where they destroyed a Confederacy [[Jammer/Legends|jamming device]] and re-established communication with their advisor.<ref name="RepCom" />

A brief [[Scanner|scan]] revealed that a [[Trandoshan dropship]] had touched down in one of the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} hangar bays. Proceeding to the hangar—after being sidetracked through the detention center by a booby-trapped [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]]—Boss and the other members of Delta Squad found that a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] had entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and was rapidly approaching the ''Prosecutor''. While their advisor called for assistance, Delta Squad was charged with repelling the [[Battle droid dispenser|droid]] [[B2 battle droid dispenser|boarding]] [[Droideka dispenser|parties]] and sealing the assault ship's hangars. By the time Boss and the others reached the final hangar, it was overrun with droids and the commandos had to resort to commandeering the roof-mounted [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]] of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] to deal with the droid threat. Following these events, the Separatist [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] opened fire on the ''Prosecutor'', deciding to cut its losses and destroy the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] before reinforcements could arrive. In an attempt to hold off the battleship, Delta Squad struggled to get the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} turbolaser battery array back online amidst a continuing assault from droid forces already onboard. Reinforcements would come in the form of [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Talbot]] and the RAS [[Arrestor (Acclamator-class)|''Arrestor'']], the only Republic force to respond to 01/425's calls for assistance. Between the combined strength of the ''Arrestor'' and ''Prosecutor''—even as the latter's hull integrity was compromised—the Confederacy [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|droid control ship]] was destroyed, shutting down the battle droids aboard the ''Prosecutor'', and saving the ship and the lives of Delta Squad. Boss and his Delta Squad brothers were commended by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] for their actions aboard the ''Prosecutor'', and the data that they retrieved would help enable the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] to better combat Trandoshan slaving operations in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="RepCom" />

===Rescue of Omega Squad===
{{Quote|Boss receiving. Sorry, we had to stop and ask for directions. My boys are now going to show you how to do an extraction ''properly'', so take notes because you might blink and miss it. There's a Sep ship with missiles up the spout about three minutes behind us.''"<br />"''Can we bring some friends?''"<br />"''The more the merrier. We're going to align with your cockpit, slap an isolation seal on the viewport, and Scorch will cut through. Then you shift it fast, and we RV with ''Fearless'' for caf, cakes, and hero worship. Got it?|Boss and Niner|<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
Delta Squad departed the ''Prosecutor'' aboard a stolen, unarmed [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], and shortly thereafter received a [[Red Zero]] signal—the Grand Army code requesting immediate extraction—from their fellow commando unit, [[Omega Squad]], in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]]. Omega was trapped aboard a [[Gizer L-6 freighter|damaged]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] at the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian]]&ndash;[[Perlemian node|Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection, with no power, limited [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], and a [[M'truli|trio]] [[Gysk|of]] [[Farr Orjul|prisoners]] suspected of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] activity, which they had [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|captured]] during an earlier [[Traffic Interdiction Operations|Traffic Interdiction Operation]]. With no other Republic forces close enough to provide the much-needed assistance, Delta Squad took it upon themselves to respond. Boss consulted with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] en route, discussing the best plan for extracting Omega with a Separatist ship moving on their location at the same time. Delta Squad arrived on scene and quickly set about rescuing their fellow commandos, while General Tur-Mukan arrived with the ''Acclamator''-class ship ''[[Fearless]]'' just in time to destroy the enemy ship before it could attack. Once Omega was safely on board, Sev nearly provoked a physical confrontation with Omega Squad member [[Atin Skirata|Atin]]; Boss made no move to intercede, leaving it to Omega Squad's sergeant, [[Niner Skirata|Niner]], to break up the budding conflict before it could come to blows. Both Delta and Omega Squads then docked aboard ''Fearless'' and returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TZ" />

===War on terror===
{{Quote|Vau made you into very impatient boys. Yes, this is where it gets boring. And you know what? You won't be any less dead if you get it wrong. And I really hope Vau schooled you well in this, because I'll be pretty hacked off if you get trigger-happy and blow this op.''"<br />"''We're pros, Sarge. We know how to do this.|Kal Skirata and Boss|<ref name="TZ" />}}
Upon setting down on Coruscant, Delta Squad disembarked from ''Fearless'' along with Omega, and were met by former ''Cuy'val Dar'' training sergeant, and now military advisor to Special Operations Brigade, [[Kal Skirata]]. Unfortunately for Boss and the others, Skirata overheard Scorch's disparaging comments made at the expense of his advanced age, and ordered the squad to perform fifty pushups. Once they were finished—although Skirata teased that they had only completed forty of the fifty he'd assigned—the commandos of Delta and Omega offloaded the three prisoners into a waiting [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] piloted by Skirata's Wookiee associate, [[Enacca]], bound for interrogation at the hands of Delta's former training sergeant, Walon Vau. A transport arrived soon after to take Delta and Omega back to Arca Barracks. At 1500 hours, Delta met with Skirata and Omega Squad in one of [[Special Operations Brigade Headquarters]]' briefing rooms, where Skirata attempted to ease the tension between the two squads, insisting that Atin and Sev leave behind their grudge and shake hands. When the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] known as [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] arrived at the meeting, Skirata informed both Delta and Omega that they would be involved in a black ops [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|strike against a terrorist cell]] operating on Coruscant.<ref name="TZ" />

[[File:DS_Boss.png|thumb|left|200px|Boss around 21 BBY.]]
Delta Squad, along with Omega and the other members of the covertly assembled strike team—now including Jedi Generals Tur-Mukan and [[Bardan Jusik]], along with Vau and Vau's pet [[Strill/Legends|strill]], [[Lord Mirdalan]]—moved into the top floor of [[Qibbu's Hut/Legends|Qibbu's Hut]], a shady [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]], owned by an associate of Skirata by the name of [[Qibbu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Over the following days, Boss and the other members of Delta Squad would take part in a rotating surveillance watch with the members of Omega, and despite conflicts between members of the two squads where their distinct personalities clashed, the two squads worked together effectively and even came to develop a respect for one another. Using Qibbu's criminal contacts, the strike team was able to lure their terrorist targets—who they determined [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]—under the pretense of having a supply of five-hundred-grade thermal [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] explosive that they were willing to sell. After a meeting between Skirata and the terrorist leader [[Perrive]] establishing a time when they would supposedly make the explosives sale, Delta Squad spent an evening enjoying themselves at Qibbu's bar with the other members of the strike team, at least until the revelry was cut short by a call from Perrive stating they would need to move up their time and change the pre-established location. Fortunately, the new location for the trade was a [[CoruFresh]] produce distribution depot in [[Quadrant F-76]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], a location Delta Squad had personally reconnoitered earlier. Together with the other strike team members, Boss and Delta Squad donned their armor again for the first time since the operation had truly begun, and moved out to end the terrorist threat.<ref name="TZ" />

At the CoruFresh depot, Boss and Scorch took positions covering the northern landing strip. Once Skirata and Jusik passed the explosives off to the terrorists and cleared the area as planned, the assembled troops struck, shutting off the lights and attacking from every direction, including the roof. Delta Squad neutralized the terrorists who fled into the [[Speeder truck/Legends|repulsortruck]] they had loaded the explosives in, ensuring that there would be no desperate suicidal detonation. A [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] strike nearly wounded Scorch, but Delta's demolitions man escaped only shaken.<ref name="TZ" /> Once the terrorists had all been killed—the assault taking no more than nine standard [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] in total—Boss and the others returned to Qibbu's for a final night, and then attended an evening as guests of the [[Coruscant Security Force Staff and Social Club|CSF Social Club]]. But just six days later, Delta Squad would be back on assignment, shipped off to [[Skuumaa]] and tasked with battlefield preparation consisting of sabotaging strategic targets ahead of the main Republic assault.<ref name="TZ" />

===Mission to Devaron===
{{Quote|There were no survivors on Devaron. Everyone was killed, including Master Halsey and his Padawan.|Boss, reporting on the fate of Halsey|<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
Boss and the clone commandos of Delta Squad were later dispatched to the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] in the aftermath of an [[Devaron massacre/Legends|attack]] by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. The squad attempted to locate any survivors of the massacre outside of the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]], but found only corpses. They recovered the bodies of Jedi Master [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his Padawan [[Knox/Legends|Knox]], and returned them to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant where they reported their findings to members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="Witches of the Mist" />

===Mygeeto===
[[File:RC-TripleZero_cover.jpg|thumb|250px|Boss, with Delta Squad at his back.]]
{{Quote|Is Vau alive?''"<br />"''Unconfirmed. We lost his signal. He had kit with him that General Jusik felt you would want to recover.''"<br />"''What ''kit''?''"<br />"''He cleaned out a bank vault. Credits, jewelry, bonds, the works. Two bags.''"<br />"''Last known position?''"<br />"''Sending you the coordinates now, with our last good ground radar scan of the terrain.|Kal Skirata and Boss|<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
Four hundred and seventy days after Geonosis, Delta Squad had been sent to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]. The squad had been tasked with calling in air strikes and sabotaging Mygeetan ground defenses near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jygat]] in preparation for [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]] and the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines']] [[Battle of Mygeeto|main assault]]. Delta completed their assignments as ordered, but instead of exfiltrating as they were supposed to, the commandos instead decided to assist their former training sergeant Vau in his personal mission, one that consisted of robbing Mygeeto's own [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]]. While Fixer held position near the squad's [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] on the planet's surface, Boss and the other two members of Delta Squad followed Vau into the underground halls of the [[Bank/Legends|bank]], where Scorch proceeded to electronically disable the locks on the main vault's door. Once inside, however, Vau refused to allow the squad to assist him any further in the heist, determined not to compromise his trainees' integrity by directly involving them in the actual act of stealing. It was during Vau's raid on the vault's numerous safety deposit boxes that Boss learned of his former training sergeant's past as a disinherited [[Count of Gesl|aristocrat]] from [[Irmenu]], and that the purpose of the theft was to regain the inheritance his [[Walon Vau's mother|mother]] and [[Walon Vau's father|father]] had denied him. When Vau ordered Delta to leave him and continue on with their assigned mission, Boss refused, reminding Vau that he was no longer a sergeant, just a civilian, and instead assisted Vau and his strill carry the stolen loot out of the bank.<ref name="TC" />

Unfortunately for both Delta Squad and Vau, their exit would become complicated when one of the bank's alarms was triggered. Although Fixer brought the snowspeeder closer to the extraction point, Delta and Vau would have to fight their way through an armed patrol of [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] and battle droids to escape. During the skirmish, Vau fell through a hole in the [[Water/Legends|ice]] and into one of the countless [[Whiteworm/Legends|crystal-worm]] tunnels that ran beneath the frozen surface of Mygeeto; although Delta Squad was determined to retrieve him, Vau forcefully commanded them to leave him and get themselves to safety. Despite severe reservations, Delta Squad did as ordered and exfiltrated from Mygeeto, although each would have some difficulty coming to terms with their perceived abandonment of their former sergeant. Boss, however, contacted Kal Skirata and Null Captain Ordo once they were off planet to inform them of Vau's situation at the behest of General Jusik; Skirata and Ordo immediately traveled to Mygeeto and managed to extract a [[Hypothermia/Legends|hypothermic]] but still alive Vau from beneath the Mygeetan ice.<ref name="TC" />

===The hunt for Ko Sai===
{{Quote|She's been gone for a year, sir. Why make the move so late in the day?''"<br />"''I'm not privy to that information, Sergeant. But the intel we do have, via the Kaminoans, suggests that she's passed through Vaynai within the last six months.''"<br />"''Who's tracking her, sir?''"<br />"''You.|Boss and General [[Arligan Zey]]|<ref name="TC" />}}
[[File:Commando_1c.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Boss with Sev and Scorch]]
Upon their return to Coruscant from Mygeeto, Delta Squad was debriefed by Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] Arligan Zey, the [[Director of Special Forces]], in his office within Special Operations Brigade Headquarters. As Delta's squad sergeant, the difficult task of explaining the complications surrounding the squad's extraction from Mygeeto fell to Boss, who avoided implicating Vau in any criminal activities with a series of carefully answered half-truths to General Zey's questions. When satisfied with Boss' accounting, Zey passed along the compliments of General [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] to the squad before detailing their next assignment: [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had ordered the capture of the rogue [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], Kamino's own former [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]]. Considering her capture as near a priority as locating the Confederacy's [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]—not only to deny her expertise to the Separatists, but primarily to have an [[Clone Master/Legends|experienced cloner]] unassociated with Tipoca under Republic control—Palpatine insisted that Zey put his most qualified squad on the assignment, from which Zey selected Delta Squad for the job. Ko Sai had gone missing during the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]], and was suspected to have [[Desertion|defected]] to the Confederacy by Kamino's [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]], [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]. Despite the length of time between her disappearance and Delta Squad's tasking of her retrieval, Kaminoan intelligence was able to track Ko Sai's movements to the planet [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. Zey insisted that Delta Squad not inform Kal Skirata of their assignment, knowing of the Mandalorian's extreme hate for Kaminoans. Unknown to Delta, Skirata was also hunting for Ko Sai, but for his own reasons: he wished to use the Kaminoan scientist to find a way to halt the accelerating aging that plagued the Grand Army's millions of clones.<ref name="TC" />

Delta Squad followed the Kaminoans' intelligence reports to Vaynai, and then on to [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]], and from there to [[Napdu]], the fourth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Da Soocha]], in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. During this time, Boss was also battling a [[Cold/Legends|cold]], from which he suffered a sore throat and repetitive cough; when Sev mentioned his annoyance at Boss' continual coughing and throat clearing over the shared [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], Boss promised to gargle with [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] at his first opportunity.<ref name="TC" /> Files acquired from the [[Nar Hej Shipping Company]] on Napdu helped Delta to further trace a pattern of movement for Ko Sai, tracking her across the Outer Rim's numerous aquatic worlds toward the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]. The squad came under attack from a [[Crusher-class starfighter|''Crusher''-class starfighter]] while leaving Napdu in one of the Grand Army's [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel|TIV]] vessels, which Boss was piloting. They touched down on Da Soocha's [[Da Soocha III|third moon]], with the ''Crusher'' continuing pursuit; on the ground, Boss used the TIV's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] to blast away one of the ''Crusher''{{'s}} wings, and both Scorch and Sev attacked the wrecked starfighter, killing the female pilot and her male copilot to Boss' annoyance—dead, they couldn't be interrogated. However, Fixer was able to access the ship's computer and determine that the pair were bounty hunters hired by the Kaminoans to track Ko Sai.<ref name="TC" />

[[File:DeltaSquad_RCcover.jpg|thumb|250px|Boss, ordering his fellow squadmates to attack]]
Using the data acquired from the Nar Hej Shipping Company, Delta Squad tracked down the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] pilot, [[Leb Chura]], on [[Bogg 4]]. Boss and the others interrogated Chura as to Ko Sai's whereabouts with the assistance of General Bardan Jusik. Chura had been moving cloning materials from [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] to [[Dorumaa]], but the Twi'lek had already relayed this information to Skirata and Vau. In order to keep Skirata and his quest a secret, Jusik [[Mind trick/Legends|influenced]] Chura to recall Mandalorians wearing [[Color/Legends|green]] armor instead of Skirata and Vau's more recognizable [[Gold/Legends|golden]] and black sets when asked, and upon learning that Chura had delivered the consignment to a location near Dorumaa's [[Tropix Island Resort]], Jusik [[Memory rub/Legends|erased]] the pilot's memory of both Delta and Skirata's band, along with deleting the records on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. In spite of this, Boss and his brothers acquired [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|SCUBA trooper]] armor and traveled to the [[Tropix Resorts|resort]] world of Dorumaa. There, they acted as part of a utilities maintenance crew in order to gather surveillance which led them to a collapsed area underneath Tropix's neighboring [[ActionWorld]] island. Upon investigating, the squad found the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] remains of a human who had been [[Chain (droid)|chained]] beneath the water, and the collapsed entrance to the facility that had previously belonged to Ko Sai. Skirata and his crew had arrived first, capturing the Kaminoan scientist, destroying the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], and taking her back to [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Skirata's home]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The squad was tasked with the slow excavation of the area; at one point they inserted a small [[strip-cam]] through an available opening, finding the armored remains of the Mandalorian bodyguards Ko Sai had hired. Though Delta found no further evidence over the next few weeks of excavation, they remained unyieldingly loyal in covering for General Jusik's absence while the Jedi Knight secretly sneaked away to aid Skirata. Five hundred and forty-eight days into the Clone Wars, Boss and the other Deltas were called back to Special Operations Brigade on Coruscant, where they were met by Kal Skirata. There, Skirata gave Sev a package containing Ko Sai's severed head; the rogue Kaminoan had taken her own life while being held on Mandalore, and was cut into pieces post-mortem. Sev then delivered Ko Sai's head to General Zey for confirmation of death, neglecting the details of how it had come into Delta's possession while still telling Zey as much of the truth as he knew using tightly wound word games.<ref name="TC" />

===Mission to Haurgab===
{{Quote|So what's the General here for, then? Other than visiting her favorite squad?''"<br />"''She hands out ''candy''. Every time she visits a squad in the field, she takes treats for them. Just like Skirata.''"<br />"''Maybe he'll teach her to garrote folks as well as he does, too.|Boss and Sev, while eating in a GAR mess hall on Haurgab|<ref name="O66" />}}
[[File:SevBossFixer.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Boss with Sev and Fixer]]
Approximately nine hundred and seventy days into the Clone Wars, Boss and the other members of Delta Squad found themselves on the Separatist-aligned [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet of [[Haurgab]]. Originally, while Jedi General [[Mlaske]] and the Grand Army's [[85th Infantry Brigade]] were already [[Battle of Haurgab|operating]] on Haurgab, the only Republic commando presence on the dusty backwater world had been Omega Squad, sent to assassinate a [[Jolluc|key leader]] of the pro-Separatist [[Maujasi]]. However, as time passed, the Republic began to assign more and more Grand Army forces to Haurgab, and Delta Squad, much to their displeasure, soon joined them.<ref name="O66" /> During a visit from General Etain Tur-Mukan—who had replaced Bardan Jusik as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of Delta Squad's [[Commando Group]], [[Zero Five Commando]], following his resignation as a Jedi General and his departure from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]—the four members of Delta Squad joined a number of other clone troops in the mess hall of [[Hadde Base|the Republic's base]] on the outskirts of the Haurgab city of [[Hadde]]. While Delta was sitting at a table with their food—trading jokes and theories on assorted topics—the base was struck by a [[Huntmaster missile|missile]] from within the city limits; though numerous troopers were killed and wounded in the attack both from the blast and the resultant shrapnel, Delta Squad had been spared the worst injuries thanks to their hardy [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn'' armor]]. The shock of being attacked in a place that had always been perceived as safe and the sight of so many dead and injured clones drove the normally lighthearted Scorch into a rage, and together with Omega Squad, General Tur-Mukan, and elements of the 85th and [[14th Infantry Brigade]]s, Boss led Delta Squad in a retaliatory strike against the rebel forces. When they arrived at the house where the missile had originated, Scorch insisted on being part of the assault team for the raid; recognizing the catharsis that confronting the responsible party would bring, Boss obliged his brother, and he and the rest of Delta stood by as security to deal with any potential attack from another source. During the shootout, four rebels were captured, while another three were killed. Death would prove not to be enough for Scorch, however: the infuriated commando dragged the rebels' lifeless bodies out into the street where he riddled them with blasterfire before finally spitting on each of the charred corpses. Boss again kept Scorch from being interfered with, holding Sev back from attempting to comfort the angry commando until he had finished.<ref name="O66" />

===Felucia===
During the war, Boss commissioned a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to defeat [[Scratch (rancor)|Scratch]], [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]], a [[B3 ultra battle droid]], and [[Yorn Nuro]].<ref name="CWA: Felucia">{{TCWA|loc=Felucia}}</ref>

===Kashyyyk===
{{Quote|I'm not leaving him, Boss. You go if you want to. Not me.''"<br />"''This is an ''order''.''"<br />"''Screw orders. Omega wouldn't leave a man.''"<br />"''Scorch&hellip;''"<br />"''You'll have to shoot me.''"<br />"''Losing one guy is bad enough. I'm not losing two. Don't let me down now. Shift it, Six-Two.''"<br />"''I'll never forgive you for this, Boss. Or you, Fixer. We're ''brothers'', for fierfek's sake. I'd never leave you.|Scorch and Boss, following an evac order after Sev loses contact under fire|<ref name="O66" />}}
[[File:LAATiDeltaSquad-RC.png|thumb|250px|Delta Squad inserting on Kashyyyk]]
Around one thousand and seventy days after the Battle of Geonosis,<ref name="O66" /> Delta Squad was sent to the Wookiee homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. Following a Separatist-backed invasion by Trandoshan slavers, the Wookiee [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] had been taken prisoner. Tarfful had spent years combating Trandoshan slaving parties, and without him the Wookiees turned to the Republic for assistance. In response, Delta Squad was deployed to Kashyyyk in order to extract Tarfful from captivity, in a [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|mission]] where Advisor 01/425 oversaw Delta yet again. Boss and the rest of Delta Squad covertly inserted into Kashyyyk via LAAT/i gunship, [[Rappel line|rappelling]] to the planet's surface from the troop bay. Once on the ground, the squad moved through the planet's dense jungle until coming upon the camp of the Trandoshan slavers. Battling their way inside, the squad was ambushed in a narrow corridor by Trandoshan mercenaries on the overhead catwalks, forcing them to escape through a maintenance shaft toward a landing zone. After securing the landing zone, the commandos caught a glimpse of a [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|Belbullab-22 starfighter]] matching the profile of General Grievous' ship, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']]. Continuing through the slavers' base, Delta freed a number of imprisoned Wookiees on their way to locate Tarfful before Delta's advisor tasked the squad with another objective: confirming Grievous' presence on Kashyyyk. Climbing a tower close to the general's landing pad, Boss and Delta managed a visual confirmation on the general, before nearly being attacked by one of Grievous' [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. Rushing down the tower, Delta Squad found Tarfful being escorted to Grievous' fighter by two MagnaGuards; although Tarfful successfully destroyed the droids on his own, Grievous fled the planet in his starfighter, leaving behind another pair of MagnaGuards. Though Grievous had initially wanted the Wookiee chieftain alive for questioning, now that the opportunity had been taken from him, the commander of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] instead ordered Tarfful dead so as to deny the Republic the valuable intelligence Tarfful possessed. Boss and the other commandos of Delta Squad engaged the deadly droids in an effort to protect Tarfful, although the Wookiee warrior refused to back down from his attackers. Together, the commandos and their Wookiee ally defeated the droids, and Tarfful was taken to Coruscant in order to enlist further Republic assistance.<ref name="RepCom" />

[[File:Kashyyyk_mission.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Boss bringing up the rear of Delta Squad while on Kashyyyk]]
Delta Squad destroyed another Trandoshan encampment not long after, before moving on the [[Kachirho Bridge|bridge]] near the Wookiee village of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].<ref name="RepCom" /> By this time, Delta had been joined by Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan on order of General Arligan Zey, who believed that she would prove beneficial to the mission. She tasked the squad with destroying the bridge: without it, the Separatist supply lines would be cut off, while the Wookiees could construct smaller bridges to circumvent the loss, an option the Confederacy's battle droids didn't have.<ref name="O66" /> Moving through an occupied market concourse, Boss and Delta fought their way through numerous Trandoshan grenadiers and heavily armed mercenaries along with another advanced spider droid and countless battle droids to reach the [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] bridge, where Delta Squad placed a [[detonation pack]] at the center of the bridge where it was weakest. However, when Boss attempted to detonate the charge, the explosives misfired. Though he was understandably angry at the setback,<ref name="RepCom" /> Scorch borrowed a [[Wookiee Guided Rocket Launcher|rocket launcher]] from a female Wookiee and used it to destroy the bridge.<ref name="O66" />

Thirteen days later, Delta continued operations on Kashyyyk, even as Coruscant came [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|under attack]] by General Grievous. While preparing to ambush a Separatist droid patrol, Scorch and Sev listened in on the comlink traffic from Coruscant, learning that only commandos in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] had received the [[Code Five]] signal to return to Coruscant immediately. When General Tur-Mukan expressed her concern for her loved ones residing on the Republic's besieged capital, Boss and the others took it upon themselves to comfort her, and when she revealed that she had a [[Venku Skirata|son]], they promised to keep her secret, with Boss going so far as to say, "We didn't even hear you tell us that. We know nothing." Though the battle droid patrol would fall victim to Wookiee-made pitfalls, Delta and Tur-Mukan ambushed a small group of Trandoshans scouting through the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]], disposing of their dead bodies via a carnivorous plant.<ref name="O66" />

[[File:RC-1138.jpg|thumb|250px|Boss in action]]
Five days later, with the crisis on Coruscant over, Delta Squad was joined on Kashyyyk by the clone forces of Jedi General [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], arriving from [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]]. In addition, General Yoda was inbound with the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion]] and Wookiee Chieftain Tarfful, set to land within thirty standard minutes. However, a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] had taken up position to engage Yoda's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and halt the debarking of additional ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. With a bit of good-natured coaxing from General Tur-Mukan, Boss and Delta Squad infiltrated a Separatist turbolaser battery complex with the intent to commandeer the contained firepower to take out the ''Recusant''-class [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]]. With Clone Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] considering alternative landing sites—each too far removed from the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|main offensive]] to be effective—Delta Squad captured one [[Wookiee dual missile turret]] for each commando, and opened fire on the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] destroyer, joined in the attack by a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of General Vos' LAAT/i gunships. After sustaining heavy damage, the ''Recusant'' destroyer began to fall, but while the majority of Delta Squad planned for a hasty exit, Sev radioed in with a report of coming under attack from multiple hostiles. When Boss ordered the squad to go back for Sev, Vos' [[Forward Air Controller/Legends|Forward Air Controller]] instead ordered Delta to leave, stating that the order had come directly from General Yoda. Though Scorch argued to the point of tears, Boss forced him to comply and moved the remaining three members of Delta Squad onto the gunship that had arrived to extract them, but not without first making a tearful, guilty apology to Sev within the private confines of his helmet.<ref name="O66" />

Aboard the gunship, Advisor 01/425 confronted Boss via hologram and ordered him to get his squad under control. The advisor then patched through a transmission from General Yoda, who stated that Delta Squad's efforts had enabled the Republic to establish forward command in Kachirho, and that the Republic would continue to rely on their skills in the coming battle. Delta Squad was then retasked with a new set of objectives for Kashyyyk.<ref name="RepCom" />

===Imperial service===
{{Quote|Would you have shot Etain if she'd still been with us when Order Sixty-six went down?''"<br />"''Academic. She wasn't.''"<br />"''Did you get a chance to ask Dar why he's still here?''"<br />"''Yeah.''"<br />"''And? What, then?''"<br />"''All he said was that he couldn't leave Niner behind.|Scorch and Boss at the Imperial Army Training Center, soon after the rise of the Galactic Empire|<ref name="O66" />}}
Not long after the conclusion of Republic action on Kashyyyk and the issuing of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which branded the Jedi traitors to the Republic who were to be shot on sight, the Clone Wars ended when the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], under the leadership of the now [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine. Nearly eleven hundred days after the Battle of Geonosis, Boss, Fixer, and Scorch found themselves stationed at the [[Imperial Army Training Center]] on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]], one of the moons of Coruscant and the location of the secret [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]-based [[Clone trooper/Legends#Palpatine.27s_Secret_Army|second clone army]] that Palpatine had created. There, they would continue to lament the loss of Sev, especially in the face of the revelation that although Omega Squad members Atin and [[Corr Skirata|Corr]] had deserted the Grand Army, Darman and Niner had joined Delta in the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] because Darman had refused to leave a [[Skirmish on Shinarcan Bridge Extension|badly wounded]] Niner behind on his own.<ref name="O66" />

Three weeks after the formation of the Galactic Empire, Delta Squad—with a replacement for Sev among their ranks—gathered at the [[501st Legion headquarters]] on Coruscant with a number of other former Republic commandos and Advanced Recon Commandos for an audience with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. There, Vader reformed the Republic's former [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] soldiers as the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], an elite unit within the Imperial [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] that would be tasked with hunting down Jedi who managed to escape Order 66, along with clone deserters, Jedi sympathizers, and other Imperial dissidents. Their serial numbers' "RC" prefix was replaced with an "IC" to denote their new position as Imperial Commandos, and the squad was also given a different and more numerical-based name, similar to the former Omega Squad being renamed "[[Squad 40]]."<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> Although initially under the command of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Sa Cuis]], the Imperial Commando Special Unit was taken over by Imperial Commander [[Roly Melusar]]—a native of the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and a man with a firm hatred of all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]]—following [[Duel on Vohai|Cuis' death]]. Melusar's zealous hate for the Jedi and all other beings who could wield the Force led Scorch to tag Melusar with the nickname "Holy Roly," a name Boss remarked would likely stick and, in fact, ''did'' among the ranks of the Imperial Commando Special Unit.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ah, one of the 'deluxe' models. Come to save us with your ''superior'' training?''"<br />"''This 'deluxe model' is the only thing standing between you and a bloody death, so you'd best be showing some respect, trooper.|Boss to a disrespectful clone trooper on board the ''Prosecutor''|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:Boss.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Delta Squad sergeant RC-1138]]
RC-1138—nicknamed "Boss" for his role as the leader of Delta Squad—was an incredibly gifted soldier. Scoring higher than most of his clone commando compatriots during his training on Kamino at a young age, Boss impressed his Mandalorian training sergeant, Walon Vau, with his prowess.<ref name="RepCom" /> Though a natural leader, Boss was relatively taciturn, and often when he did speak, it was to issue an order to his squad. Boss earned the respect and loyalty of his Delta Squad comrades, and did his best to repay their faith in him with strong, effective leadership.<ref name="TCSWE" /> He cared a great deal for his squadmates and, like most other clone commandos, viewed his team as brothers, with Sev being the closest to him.<ref name="TC" />

Despite being raised and trained by ''Cuy'val Dar'' sergeant Walon Vau, Boss came to speak with Jango Fett's [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] accent and [[Concordian/Legends|speech]] patterns<ref name="TCSWE" />—though this trait was common to the flash-learned standard clone troops, as well.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RCcover.jpg|thumb|225px|Boss, prominently displayed on the cover of the ''Star Wars: Republic Commando'' game]]
RC-1138, or Boss, first appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'' by [[Karen Traviss]], a tie-in to the then-upcoming [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', where Boss was predominantly featured as the player-controlled character. Traviss later featured Boss and all of his Delta Squad comrades in the rest of her [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels, including [[Republic Commando: Triple Zero|''Triple Zero'']], [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], and ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''. Boss also received an entry in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.

Boss' numerical designation, RC-1138, is [[1138 (easter egg)|yet another homage]] to [[George Lucas]]'s first film, [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX 1138'']]. In ''Star Wars: Republic Commando'', Boss was voiced by [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Temuera Morrison]], who portrayed Jango Fett in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] and a number of other prominent clone characters in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. ''Star Wars: Republic Commando'' has an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] in which Boss discovers a discarded [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] aboard the assault ship ''Prosecutor''. There is also an Easter egg in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' in an area of the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility|facility]]. If a pile of crates is stacked and used to jump up to a ledge, Boss' [[Color/Legends|orange]]-painted helmet can be found.

Boss was made into a [[Champions of the Force (Star Wars Miniatures)|Star Wars Miniatures: Champions of the Force]] figure. He and the rest of his squad appeared as an action figure alongside three Geonosian warriors. Boss still can't be found in his own official box, but plenty of websites sell prepackaged Boss with his weapons. In ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', an [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commando]] in service of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] says, "Delta 1138 is Down." However,whether they are referring to Boss is unknown. Boss was one of the four Delta Squad members made into a bust by [[Gentle Giant Studios]]. Each bust is exclusive to a single country in the world, and all have a limited edition of 1300 worldwide. Boss' bust is exclusive in the Netherlands, Fix's in Japan, Sev's in the UK, and Scorch's in the United States.

Temuera Morrison stated that Boss is the closest clone there is to Jango Fett.

Along with the rest of his squad, Boss appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' third-season episode "[[Witches of the Mist]]," where he is voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].
